test_title: PYST 87: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
'E × F' means ' E is the wife of F'

'E + F' means 'E is the brother of F'

'E ÷ F' means 'E is the sister of F'

'E - F' means 'E is the son of F'

How is S related to l in the expression 'S + H × I + J'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Son 
 Wife 
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: S + H × I + J

It means: S is the brother of H, H is the wife of I and I is the brother of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85cb6f54bb2c68cf11beb2190416d470c46a06fed12ba162fbf9164a5556965d.png] 

So, S is the **'Wife's brother**' of I.

Hence, the correct answer is "'Wife's brother".
